title: Readable entity contracts
responsibility: Converts declared interfaces and category-specific context into readable contract rows.

inputs.name: requiredStates.unit
inputs.description: The unit whose required states are listed; only its id is read, to find the scenarios that name it and to narrow each of them. A unit that no scenario names gets an empty list.

examples.title: Evidence grid
examples.responsibility: Shows the captures of one state as a grid of tiles.

inputs.name: captures
inputs.description: The captures of the state to show, in the order they were recorded.

inputs.name: requiredStates.scenarios
inputs.description: The scenario declarations to examine: only those whose units list names the unit count, and only their states that scenarioFor keeps for the unit with coverage 'required' are listed. Declared order is kept, and a state id shared by several scenarios is listed once.

inputs.name: requiredStates.units
inputs.description: The registry the states are read against: a visual unit (page, shell, component, layout or partial) is shown by the states that name it or name nothing; any other unit by the states that name it, else by those naming an active unit that depends on it to any depth, else by every state. A unit missing from this list has no kind, so it is not treated as visual.

examples.title: Evidence grid
examples.responsibility: Shows the captures of one state as a grid of tiles.

inputs.name: captures
inputs.description: The captures of the state to show, in the order they were recorded.

inputs.name: entityContract.unit
inputs.description: The unit whose contract is described: its responsibility shows for pages and configs, its runtime targets for services, and its contract inputs, outputs and errors, each as far as its category shows them. A markup output named like its title, one of its symbols or one of its file names without endings reads 'rendered markup'.

examples.title: Evidence grid
examples.responsibility: Shows the captures of one state as a grid of tiles.

inputs.name: captures
inputs.description: The captures of the state to show, in the order they were recorded.

inputs.name: entityContract.facts
inputs.description: The display category that selects the rows, and an optional web address of a page. Only pages show the address, as 'App route', with 'Not recorded' when it is null, undefined or empty.

inputs.name: humanize.name
inputs.description: The identifier to split into words, in any casing: camel-case, acronym boundaries and runs of '_', '-' or '.' separate them. Surrounding whitespace is trimmed, and an empty string gives an empty result.

outputs.name: humanize
outputs.description: The identifier as lowercase words: a space at each camel-case, acronym, or '_', '-' or '.' boundary, with a run of separators becoming one space. The ends are trimmed of whitespace; other characters, including spaces already inside the text, are kept.

outputs.name: requiredStates
outputs.description: The unique ids of the required states of the scenarios that name the unit, each narrowed for it, in first-seen order. Missing and inapplicable states never appear, and the list is empty when no scenario names the unit.

outputs.name: entityContract
outputs.description: The rows for the unit's category: pages show Purpose, App route, Inputs and Output; configs show Purpose and Provides; components show Props; any other category shows Inputs and Output, with services adding Runs as; Fails with is added for every category but configs when the unit declares errors. Rows list their fields as items, with 'No description recorded.' for undescribed ones, once any field has a description; a markup output named like its unit's title, symbols or files reads 'rendered markup', and no row holds verification states, files, symbols or types.

items.name: captures
items.text: The captures of the state to show, in the order they were recorded.
